Waldemar Prinski is a human cultist of Bane. His corpse is in the Iron Throne during Act Three. He was primarily responsible for creating the  Motivators to enslave the Gondians in the Steel Watch Foundry.

History

Prinski worked heavily with  Enver Gortash in creating the Motivators to control the Gondians, and was instrumental in creating the Iron Throne alongside a rogue member of the Church of Umberlee, Dark Breaker Antiope who handled and controlled the Sahuagin. At some point, he likely ran afoul of Gortash, as his corpse is now in the Iron Throne.
